dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: What should tonight's menu be...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Oh, right. I'm working on tonight's menu. After much contemplation, I decided on fish for the main dish, to go with a few special drinks...

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: I'm sure those gentlemen will be pleased.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Thanks to the God King's grace, the spices I ordered finally arrived on time, and combined with some fish fresh from the ocean...

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Well, feel free to stay and have a taste! Trust me, fish are my specialty!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: B—Bye!

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Oh, going already? Alright then, take care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to make a cannon?

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Me? No, no, this cannon was designed by Mécantre and Babisse. I just had some... peripheral participation in the discussions.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Even though the design philosophy and purpose of this cannon are intriguing to say the least, I must say that this line of thinking is quite... well, overboard.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: A "daydream" in all senses of the word.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Putting aside the cannon material and the shape of the projectile it must fire, immense amounts of propellant must be expended to fire any shell up to the altitude they desire...

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Hehe, the fuel they'd need could stuff four or five cannons of this caliber to the brim.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: ...That said, I reckon it's not a bad thing that their research continues. My guidance may yet ensure that their work bears fruit that will be useful in other fields...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Hmm? You've not heard of me? Well, I suppose you don't look like researchers on the cutting edge either.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Bossuet's the name. I once worked at the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: If you have time to visit the Institute, I'm sure you'll find many an academic achievement credited to me, and researchers who have received my mentorship.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Ah, but that said, I'm not providing professional guidance at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: I've retired from my research post, and am here in peaceful retirement. If you wanted professional aid, I fear I must disappoint you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: You don't know of me? Or rather, you don't recognize me? Oh, wonderful. Raimondo and Choiseul's plan to erase me from the Institute has gone swimmingly. How happy I am for them.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance, Honorary Senior Researcher. I am Bossuet, and I once worked at the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: I believe you might have found many a fruit of my academic labor in the Institute, and met some of my mentees to boot. Your fame has reached me here, thanks to the trusty Steambird.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Oh, by the way, I've resigned from my post as a researcher, and I'm here in quiet retirement. Not taking mentorships at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: So if that's what you were looking for, you're going to be disappointed, I fear.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: See you. Take care now.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: This cannon's design is fascinating... Most interesting indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Fish... Ah, yes, that's right. This is the fish I discovered most recently...
